D3: protocol.audit_links is empty; no audit PDFs surfaced from website or GitHub search. Zero addresses from this corpus.

D4: protocol.github is empty (none recorded). DeFiLlama dimension-adapters repo (https://github.com/DefiLlama/dimension-adapters/blob/master/fees/sentora.ts) fetched as a third-party indexing source; it revealed 7 BoringVault addresses on Ethereum (4 mirrored on Ink), 3 supervised-loan manager addresses on Ethereum, a Sentora API endpoint (https://services.vaults.sentora.com/vaults) enumerating Morpho/Euler/Upshift/Kamino vault addresses dynamically, and the WETH/WEETH token references. No Sentora-owned GitHub repo discovered.

D5: Ethereum and Ink addresses catalogued. Solana chain: zero addresses surfaced from fetched sources (DeFiLlama adapter fetches Kamino API dynamically; Solana addresses not embedded in the TypeScript file). Tempo chain: zero addresses surfaced from any fetched source. Both recorded in unknowns.

D6: The Sentora API (https://services.vaults.sentora.com/vaults) acts as the factory enumeration source for Morpho, Euler, and Upshift vaults — it is called at runtime by the DeFiLlama adapter to discover vault addresses dynamically. The API URL was surfaced from the fetched GitHub file but was not itself fetched (not a pre-approved surfacer URL). Factory-discovered children are recorded in unknowns pending a fetch of that API endpoint.

D7: All admin_addresses entries use controlled vocabulary. BoringVaults labelled as 'vault (BoringVault)'; supervised loan managers as 'other (supervised-loan-manager)'; Morpho vault as 'vault (Morpho ERC4626)'. actor_class set to 'unknown' for all — no on-chain bytecode reads performed this run.

D8: All 13 admin_addresses entries trace to the fetched dimension-adapters GitHub file or the Morpho app search snippet. No snippet-only sightings promoted to admin_addresses without a traceable fetch source.

rationale.verdict: Walked sentora.com, vaults.sentora.com, defillama.com/protocol/sentora, defillama.com/protocol/sentora-curator, and the DeFiLlama dimension-adapters fee adapter for Sentora. Catalogued 13 contract addresses across Ethereum and Ink (7 BoringVaults + 3 supervised-loan managers + 1 Morpho vault + 2 token references). Solana and Tempo chain addresses, Morpho/Euler/Upshift vault enumeration (Sentora API), audits, and Sentora's own GitHub remain unresolved.

protocol_metadata.about: Sentora is an institutional DeFi risk curator that designs and manages yield strategies across multiple chains, allowing capital to be deposited into non-custodial vaults curated by Sentora's risk models. Users deposit assets into vaults built on protocols such as Morpho, Euler v2, BoringVault (Kraken Earn family), Upshift, and Kamino; Sentora acts as the curator, setting risk parameters and earning performance or management fees. The protocol also operates supervised-loan strategies where weETH collateral is deployed on Morpho to generate leveraged restaking yield, on which Sentora charges a 10% performance fee.
